definitions.gloss: the Hinomaru; the Japanese national flag
definitions.explanation: The national flag of Japan, featuring a red circle on a white background. The red circle represents the sun.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{丸|まる}が{風|かぜ}に{揺|ゆ}れている。
examples.english: The Hinomaru is swaying in the wind.

examples.japanese: オリンピックで{日|ひ}の{丸|まる}が{掲|かか}げられた。
examples.english: The Hinomaru was raised at the Olympics.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{丸|まる}の{白|しろ}と{赤|あか}は{日本|にほん}を{象徴|しょうちょう}する{色|いろ}だ。
examples.english: The white and red of the Hinomaru are colors that symbolize Japan.

notes:
{日|ひ}の{丸|まる} is the common everyday name for Japan's national flag, a red disc on a white background representing the sun. The name literally means "circle of the sun" — from {日|ひ} (sun) + の + {丸|まる} (circle).

FORMAL NAME:
The official name is {日章旗|にっしょうき} (Flag of the Sun). {日|ひ}の{丸|まる} is the informal name used in daily conversation.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Hinomaru has been used as a symbol of Japan for centuries. It was officially designated as the national flag in 1999 by the Act on National Flag and Anthem.
